maria-cs: quick sync for DeltaCorp Dedicated bring-up. they want quota, autoscale, and a concise load test plan + failure samples. target maintenance window: Fri 02:00-05:00 UTC. who can take what? :wave:
nina-ops: I will own quota. customer commit ~150k req/day, steady ~1.2k rps, burst up to 2.5k. proposing reserved 5 GPUs, min_instances=5, max_instances=15, soft-throttle at 95th pct before fallback.
lee-sre: packing note: with current batching one node ~=220 rps at seq64. 5 nodes ~=1100 rps. to hit 2.5k need max_instances >= 12 or enable cross-node packing. recommend max_instances=15.
anj-ml: model warmup: cold kv-cache adds ~15s on first long prompt. suggest a priming job that hits top 100 prefixes 4x per node 10m before test. also prepare model-compact fallback.
maria-cs: plan outline:
- Thu 02:30 UTC: smoke test (10m)
- Fri 02:00-03:30 UTC: soak @70% for 60m
- Fri 03:30-03:35 UTC: spike @150% for 5m
- capture top failing prompts and request_ids
carl-delta: confirmed windows ok. please capture failure samples and share immediately after run.
nina-ops: quota config draft:
- reserved_nodes: 5
- min_instances: 5
- max_instances: 15
- scale_metrics: token_rate + queue_length
- soft_throttle: 95th_pct -> throttle_factor 0.9
- fallback_model: model-compact-v2
lee-sre: load test (k6) snippet:
```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function(){ http.post('https://api.redwood/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({prompt:'summarize'}), {headers:{Authorization:'Bearer $TOKEN'}}) }
```
run: `k6 run --vus 2500 --duration 00:50:00 script.js`
anj-ml: warmup script (bash): `for i in {1..4}; do curl -s -X POST $ENDPOINT -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' & done` — schedule 10m prior.
deploy-bot: scheduled warmup job for 2024-11-21T01:50:00Z (job id warmup-173500).
maria-cs: action items: @nina-ops finalize quota PR and include soft-throttle, @lee-sre publish loadscript + run commands, @anj-ml share priming list + failure-capture logic, i'll send runbook to Delta and collect acknowledgements.
lee-sre: rollback steps quick: stop generator, set max_instances=min_instances=5, enable `use_fallback=true`, monitor p95 for 10m, escalate if error_rate>2%.
nina-ops: alerts: queue_len>200 -> page SRE, token_error_rate>0.5% -> page ops.
carl-delta: thanks team. please include a brief SLA impact note when you share the runbook.
maria-cs: will do. prepping final runbook now, sending EOD. :rocket:
